semanticGroups.name: Shared Manual Platform
semanticGroups.summary: 全系列共享手冊平台：模組註冊章節，伺服器負責取得、合併、遷移與刷新；實體 written_book 僅保存封面與章節索引，Client 以無原版頁數上限的 virtual pages、雙頁版面、可點擊目錄、頁面 filter 與 overlay 擴充呈現內容。
notes: TotemManualAssembler schema version is 3 and records a SHA-256 content revision.
splitHeldManual is a deprecated compatibility endpoint; manual splitting is disabled and must not be presented as an active feature.
Page visibility filters are process-local; canonical server metadata keeps the full page set deterministic.

semanticGroups.name: Versioned Event Bus & Lifecycle Contracts
semanticGroups.summary: Process-local、版本化的可選跨模組事件匯流排。Core 定義 immutable event contracts，subscriber 失敗會被隔離並記錄，不回滾已完成 gameplay；事件只攜帶必要的公開／稽核資料，不讓 Core 接管來源模組狀態。
notes: Current event records report contractVersion() == 1.
LockedContainerNetworkBrokenEvent deliberately excludes inventory, ACL, keys and complete topology data.

semanticGroups.name: Friendship Authority & Persistence
semanticGroups.summary: 全系列唯一的 server-authoritative 好友資料來源：好友關係為 mutual，邀請在接受前保持 directional；API 提供查詢、邀請／接受與解除關係，持久化同時保存 friendships 與 pending invites。
notes: Persistence identifier intentionally remains deadrecall:space_friends so existing worlds reuse the same data without destructive copy migration.
Feature modules should consume TotemFriendshipApi rather than mirror social state.

semanticGroups.name: Observer Semantic Screen SPI
semanticGroups.summary: framebuffer-free 的語意化遠端 Screen 契約。畫面擁有模組透過 Fabric entrypoint 提供 family/protocol/variant provider，Coordinator 傳送 bounded semantic snapshot 與 logical cursor，Provider 建立真正 owner Screen 並套用狀態；read-only marker 用於阻止 Observer 畫面再次被轉播。
notes: Provider entrypoint key is totem:observer_screen_provider.
Snapshot transport caps include 256 slots, 128 data ints, 64 metadata entries, 2048-character text and 64 KiB owner payload.
ownerPayload stays opaque to the coordinator and is decoded by the Screen-owning module.

semanticGroups.name: World Outline & Voxel Wireframe API
semanticGroups.summary: Client-only、無狀態的世界輪廓提交與幾何規劃 API。支援 block、AABB cuboid、任意兩點 line，以及不規則 voxel union 的外部 wireframe；樣式包含 ARGB、線寬與 depth-tested／through-walls occlusion。
notes: VoxelUnionOutline removes internal shared edges, coplanar seams and enclosed cavity surfaces, then merges collinear unit edges into deterministic maximal segments.
A face-connected component whose padded envelope exceeds 1,000,000 cells is rejected as a safety bound.

semanticGroups.name: Death Integration Contracts
semanticGroups.summary: 死亡流程的跨模組掛接點，而不是 Core 自己的死亡玩法。DeathBackpackNodeLifecycle 讓外部 authority 建立／綁定／回滾／回收死亡背包節點；DeathRetainedItemPolicy 只授權某物品是否可保留，真正 extraction、persistence 與 exactly-once restore 仍由死亡流程擁有模組負責。
notes: DeathBackpackNodeLifecycle.bind exists so reverse links can be persisted without loading chunks to search entities.
DeathRetainedItemPolicy does not own extraction or restoration.

semanticGroups.name: Legacy Item Decode & Migration
semanticGroups.summary: 舊 DeadRecall item namespace 的永久 decode/migration 相容層。Core 先註冊 placeholder aliases 讓舊世界即使缺少原功能模組仍可安全載入，之後在 canonical owner item 可解析時再延遲 transmute；目前內建 14 個 legacy item mappings。
notes: Legacy stacks remain intact when their owning feature module is temporarily absent.
Built-in mappings cover Remnant backpacks/death backpack, Automata copper wrench and multiple Alchemy items.

semanticGroups.name: Legacy Exact Module Version Gate
semanticGroups.summary: Configuration phase 的 exact client/server module-version handshake。它只在 legacy deadrecall mod 仍載入時啟用；Server 發送固定模組集合的版本，Client 回傳自身集合，任何 missing/version mismatch 都會在進入遊戲前拒絕連線。
notes: This is legacy DeadRecall compatibility behavior, not TotemCore API-version negotiation.
ModuleVersionSet uses a fixed ordered module-id list and represents absent modules as <missing>.

semanticGroups.name: Shared API & Runtime Facilities
semanticGroups.summary: 小型但跨模組共用的基礎設施：ApiVersion 提供 major/minor compatibility 判定；TotemGameRuleCategories 註冊共用 totem:rules 分類，讓各 Totem 模組規則集中出現在原版 Game Rules UI。
notes: ApiVersion.V1 is 1.0 and supports the same major with an equal-or-newer minor.
TotemCore initialization also boots manual onboarding, legacy aliases and compatibility networking.
